content: उपलभ् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To know, understand, see, perceive (directly); सव्यदक्षिणयोर्यत्र विशेषो नोपलभ्यते <ls>Pt. 1. 76</ls>; अन्या प्रतिक्रिया नोपलभ्यते <ls>K. 152</ls>. .²2 To ascertain, find out, learn, know; ब्रूहि यदुपलब्धम् <ls>U. 1</ls>; तत्त्वत एनामुपलप्स्ये <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; <ls>Mv. 7. 30</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 60</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 27</ls>; <ls>K. 159</ls>; <ls>M. 41</ls>, <ls n="M.">3. 6</ls>, <ls n="M.">4. 6</ls>. .²3 To get, obtain, acquire, enjoy, experience (happiness <ab>&c.</ab>); उपलब्धसुखः <ls>Ku. 4. 42</ls> experiencing; कथमुपलभे निद्राम् <ls>V. 2. 10</ls> enjoy; इदानीं स्मृतिरुपलब्धा <ls>Mu. 2</ls> now I recollect; <ls>Ms. 11. 17</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 82</ls>, <ls n="R.">10. 2</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 21</ls>. .²4 To conceive, become pregnant. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to get; बुभुजे च श्रियं स्वृद्धां द्विजदेवोपलम्भिताम् <ls>Bhāg. 8. 15. 37</ls>. .²2 To produce, bring about.
